title: Minimum Time to Finish the Race
goal: Finish all race laps in minimum time while choosing when to change tires.
strategy: Precompute the cheapest uninterrupted run of each useful length. Stop extending a tire once its next lap is slower than changing to the fastest fresh tire, then partition the race with DP.
